notes.title: VectorWars has Launched!
notes.content:
http://www.redironlabs.com/Downloads/Steam/Steam-VectorWarsUpdate.jpg 

We are proud to announce that VectorWars has released! 

Wow, what an incredible week we have had.  

It has taken a lot of work to get this game prepped and ready for VR.

We've done a lot of testing for both VR and non-VR players - but bugs sometimes come up that we have missed.  So please, let us know if you see anything weird!

We want to keep making this game amazing, so keep us posted on things you loved or didn't like :).
